name: CohortLens Question Pack V1.1
description: V1.1 replaces Layer A with a voluntary six-part political-theoretical profile; Layers B/C remain unchanged from V1.0.
measurementNotice: Layer A is a voluntary political-theoretical profile, not a political reliability or purity test.
A0 is direct self-report only and must never be inferred from A1-A5.
A2-A4 are primarily descriptive evidence cards in V1.1; do not create pseudo-precise axis scores from sparse samples.
Layer A must not be used for automatic admission/rejection or role-fit.
